{{Top}}
A '''Dynamic hammer''' was a type of [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibrotool]] that was developed for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Using a vibration system to move the head of the hammer, as it struck an object, it caused an almost explosive impact.

During an argument, [[Sander Delvardus]] was said to have struck his mistress, [[Seledra-Zin]], with one. The resultant blow rendered her [[Coma/Legends|comatose]].
